title: The ridge from the dock, by day
logline: The ridge from Gully's dock at noon in May, plain green, the clear-cut's scar, no glow. Three months before the glow shows by day. The page stores the ridge without it.

panels.composition: A wooded ridge beyond a small town seen from a dock at noon, plain green with an old clear-cut's paler patch, no glow, gulls.
